summary: Restore the full speaker comment as a note

data.note: (Ilyas prefers ʕyoṭo, but is ready to accept teʕiṭo as a productive pattern)

rationale: The translation field holds only the opening of a speaker comment, not a translation of ʕyoṭo/teʕiṭo. The raw example preserves the full parenthetical comment. Clear the spurious translation and move that complete comment into note. No new translation is supplied.
